Para quem e para quê: a rede atendida, o: Who it is for and what for: the system served, the problem to solve and the AI governance the system already has.
Um retrato da rede e do problema, que ge: A picture of the system and the problem, which generates the suggestions in the next phases and starts the procurement plan.
De 15 a 25 minutos, com os números da re: 15 to 25 minutes, with the system's numbers at hand. Your answers are saved and you can come back later.

As premissas de custo do teste (Ano 0):: The cost assumptions for the test (Year 0): tool, payment, size of the test, internet, devices, training and support.
De 20 a 30 minutos. Parte das respostas: 20 to 30 minutes. Some answers come suggested and you only need to confirm them.
Com quantas escolas e pessoas começa o u: How many schools and people start real use, and how the tool connects to the system's information systems.
A primeira etapa da implantação (Ano 1): The first stage of deployment (Year 1) and the architecture of the tool, which changes the cost of integration and security.
Até onde o uso pode chegar, em quanto te: How far use can grow, how quickly, and over how many years the system wants to estimate the cost.
A estimativa de custo por ano e por cama: The cost estimate by year and by layer, the appropriation to request for each fiscal year and the recommendations for the case. The values are illustrative.

Escolhe como a rede testa a IA antes de: Chooses how the system tests AI before buying: [[poc|proof of concept]], [[piloto|pilot]] or both.

Marque as duas, ou peça uma recomendação: Tick both, or ask for a recommendation.
Prova de conceito de 2 meses e, depois,: A 2-month proof of concept and, afterwards, a pilot in 20 schools.
Registra onde a decisão será tomada e qu: Records where the decision will be made and how many schools and students the case covers.
O número de escolas e de estudantes dime: The number of schools and students sets licenses, training, support and devices, and therefore the cost.
Use o cadastro oficial de escolas e matr: Use the official register of schools and enrollment.
Diz que problema da rede você quer resol: Says which problem in the system you want to solve, without mentioning technology.
O problema define o que a ferramenta faz: The problem sets what the tool does and who uses it. A [[linhabase|baseline]] shows later whether the spending paid off.
Escolha a prioridade e marque os problem: Pick the priority and tick the problems.
Metade dos estudantes do 5º ano rural nã: Half of rural grade-5 students do not read fluently.

gabinete, assessoria jurídica e proteção: the cabinet office, legal advice and data protection

Descreve o que a IA fará no dia a dia da: Describes what AI will do in the school's daily routine, not the product.
A tarefa define quem usa e com que frequ: The task sets who uses it and how often, and that changes licenses, training and support.
Marque uma ou mais tarefas; as sugeridas: Tick one or more tasks; the suggested ones come from the problem in step 1.2.
Diz quem usa a ferramenta, quem recebe o: Says who uses the tool, who receives the result and how often.
Mais pessoas e mais uso significam mais: More people and more use mean more licenses, more training and, for tools paid by use, more cost.
Confirme ou ajuste as respostas sugerida: Confirm or adjust the answers suggested by the tasks.
área pedagógica e coordenação das escola: the education team and school coordination
Professores do 6º ao 9º ano usam; os est: Teachers of grades 6 to 9 use it; students receive the activities.
Registra as ferramentas, como se pagam,: Records the tools, how they are paid for, the license and how much to adapt.
Preço, forma de pagamento e adaptação de: Price, payment method and adaptation set the cost of Year 0 and what repeats every year ([[recorrente|recurring cost]]).
Se ainda não escolheu, responda “Ainda n: If you have not chosen yet, answer “I don't know yet”.
Assinatura de [[saas|SaaS]] por professo: A [[saas|SaaS]] subscription per teacher per month, with accounts and classes set up.
Diz se as escolas têm internet e disposi: Says whether schools have internet and devices to use the tool.
Conexão nova é [[recorrente|custo recorr: New connectivity is a [[recorrente|recurring cost]]; new devices are a purchase, usually from the [[capital|capital budget]].
Pergunte às escolas ou use o último leva: Ask the schools or use the latest infrastructure survey.
Em 400 das 600 escolas a internet aguent: In 400 of the 600 schools the internet can support a whole class.
Planeja quem será formado, em que format: Plans who will be trained, in what format and for how many hours.
A formação está entre os fatores que mai: Training is among the factors that weigh most on the total cost: each person's hours, paid or taken from work.
Without the hours, use “Use an estimate”.
4 horas de oficina e 4 de acompanhamento: 4 hours of workshop and 4 of in-class follow-up: 8 hours per teacher.
Diz quem atende as dúvidas e os problema: Says who answers questions and problems from schools and how the system follows use.
Suporte e acompanhamento ocupam equipes: Support and follow-up occupy teams every year; that time is measured in [[eti|FTE]].
Escolha quem dá o suporte e o nível dese: Choose who gives support and the level you want.
O fornecedor atende pelo chat; a equipe: The vendor answers by chat; the system's team handles access and accounts.
Define quantas escolas e pessoas começam: Sets how many schools and people start using it right after the test.
É o Ano 1 da estimativa: licenças, forma: It is Year 1 of the estimate: licenses, training, support and devices grow with the number of people.
Use a sugestão ou informe o que a rede c: Use the suggestion or enter what the system can serve.
200 escolas e 4.000 professores no prime: 200 schools and 4,000 teachers in the first year.
Escolhe como a ferramenta funciona e se: Chooses how the tool works inside and connects to the system's information systems: ready-made product ([[saas|SaaS]]), [[api|API]] or [[pesos|open weights]].
O arranjo muda o custo de integração, de: The arrangement changes the cost of integration, security and exiting the contract.
Se não souber, use a arquitetura presumi: If you do not know, use the assumed architecture.
A rede assina um assistente pronto e o f: The system subscribes to a ready-made assistant and the vendor runs everything.
Define até onde o uso chega, em quanto t: Sets how far use goes, how quickly, and over how many years to estimate.
É a base da estimativa: o custo anual cr: It is the basis of the estimate: the annual cost grows with the number of people who use it.
Informe as pessoas da rede toda, mesmo q: Enter the people in the whole system, even if only part start now.
12.000 professores em 2 anos, custo esti: 12,000 teachers within 2 years, cost estimated over 5 years.
Mostra o custo total ([[tco|TCO]]) por a: Shows the total cost ([[tco|TCO]]) by year and by [[camada|layer]], and the [[dotacao|appropriation]] for each fiscal year.
Separa o que se paga uma vez ([[capital|: Separates what is paid once ([[capital|capital budget]]) from what repeats ([[corrente|current budget]]).
Nada a responder: ajuste na calculadora: Nothing to answer: adjust the [[desconto|discount rate]] and the [[p10p90|P10–P90]] ranges in the calculator.
Dispositivos do Ano 0 vão ao orçamento d: Year 0 devices go to the capital budget; the annual subscription, to the current budget.
Lista as ações para este caso, por prior: Lists the actions for this case, by priority, from your answers.
Mostra o que fazer antes do teste e de c: Shows what to do before the test and before contracting, with cost and purchasing kept apart from policy.
Nada a responder: leia as de prioridade: Nothing to answer: read the high-priority ones and use “Go to the question”.
quem coordena a compra e a assessoria ju: whoever coordinates the purchase, and legal advice
Sem medida do problema, a lista pede med: With no measure of the problem, the list asks for one first.
Estes números dimensionam licenças, form: These numbers set licenses, training and support. The system's register of schools and enrollment will do.
Sem uma [[linhabase|linha de base]], não: Without a [[linhabase|baseline]], you cannot tell later whether AI helped.
Na [[poc|prova de conceito]] testa-se a: The [[poc|proof of concept]] tests the technology; the [[piloto|pilot]], real use.
Cada tarefa muda quem usa a ferramenta e: Each task changes who uses the tool and how much, and that changes the cost.
Em ferramentas pagas por uso, mais uso s: For tools paid by use, more use means more cost.
Cada ferramenta tem a sua licença, adapt: Each tool has its own license, adaptation and support, and adds to the cost.
O preço é por licença por mês. Uma cotaç: The price is per license per month. A vendor quote gives the value closest to reality.
Gratuita não é o mesmo que sem custo: fo: Free is not the same as costless: training, support and integration are still paid for.
Por usuário ou por consumo, o custo cres: Per user or by consumption, the cost grows with use; the institutional fee is fixed and repeats every year ([[recorrente|recurring cost]]).
A licença diz o que a rede pode fazer co: The license says what the system can do with the tool, for how long and what happens on exit.
Ajustar contas e turmas é simples; ligar: Setting up accounts and classes is simple; linking to the system's information systems or programming needs a technical team, measured in [[eti|FTE]].
Participantes e meses definem as licença: Participants and months set the licenses and support for Year 0.
Conexão nova é [[recorrente|custo recorr: New connectivity is a [[recorrente|recurring cost]]: a monthly fee per school, every year.
O modelo de uso define quantos dispositi: The usage model sets how many devices the system needs to buy.
Dispositivos novos são uma compra, em ge: New devices are a purchase, usually from the [[capital|capital budget]].
O custo é horas por pessoa × pessoas for: The cost is hours per person × people trained × cost per hour.
Se o fornecedor ou um parceiro paga, o c: If the vendor or a partner pays, the cost shows in the total but not in the system's [[dotacao|appropriation]].
Mais suporte significa mais tempo de equ: More support means more team time, measured in [[eti|FTE]].
Acompanhar mais exige mais tempo de gest: More follow-up takes more management and monitoring time from the team.
Estas pessoas entram no Ano 1 da estimat: These people enter in Year 1 of the estimate and set the licenses, training and support for that year.
Produto pronto ([[saas|SaaS]]), aplicaçã: Ready-made product ([[saas|SaaS]]), an application that uses an [[api|API]] or an [[pesos|open-weights]] model: each has different costs.
Todas as pessoas que usariam a ferrament: Everyone who would use the tool: the annual [[recorrente|recurring cost]] grows with this number.
Um horizonte maior mostra o custo de man: A longer horizon shows the cost of keeping the tool running, not only of starting it.
Camadas 2, 3 e 6 · Aplicações de IA, exp: Layers 2, 3 and 6 · AI applications, user experience and adoption (layer 2); infrastructure and devices (layer 3); training and team capacity (layer 6). In this first stage the three grow together, because they depend on the number of schools and people who start using the tool. The notes for steps 2.1, 2.4 and 2.5 give what Krueger and Jackson (2026, p. 11) say about each layer.
Custo de ter a ferramenta ao longo de to: The cost of having the tool over its whole life, not only the purchase price: it includes internet, devices, training, support and team time.
Meio pelo qual um programa usa outro pel: A way for one program to use another over the internet. Here, an application uses a company's AI model and the system pays according to use.
Modelo de IA publicado para qualquer pes: An AI model published for anyone to install and use. The system runs it on its own or contracted servers and is responsible for operation and security.
Medida do tempo de trabalho: uma pessoa: A measure of working time: one person for the whole year counts as 1; two people half-time also count as 1.
Dinheiro para compras que duram vários a: Money for purchases that last several years, such as devices or the linking to information systems. The rules differ from country to country: check with the budget office.
Dinheiro para as despesas que se repetem: Money for expenses that repeat, such as subscriptions, support, connectivity and training. The classification depends on each jurisdiction's budget rules.
Percentual usado para comparar valores p: A percentage used to compare amounts paid in different years: an amount paid later weighs less in the total. Zero means no discounting. Use your jurisdiction's official rate.
Custo que se repete todo ano enquanto a: A cost that repeats every year while the tool is in use, such as subscriptions, support and connectivity. It does not include what is paid once, such as buying devices.
Produto pronto que a rede assina e usa p: A ready-made product that the system subscribes to and uses through a browser or app. The vendor runs everything.
Teste técnico, com a equipe e dados de t: A technical test, with the team and test data, to see whether the solution works. There are no real teachers or students.
Teste de uso real: professores ou estuda: A test of real use: teachers or students in a few schools use the tool for a limited time.
Cada uma das sete partes do custo total: Each of the seven parts of the total cost of AI in education, in the framework of Krueger and Jackson (2026, p. 11): from governance to operation and sustainability.
Faixa de uma simulação de incerteza. Em: A range from an uncertainty simulation. In 10% of scenarios the value falls below P10 and in 10% above P90; in the remaining 80%, between the two.
Medida do problema antes de a IA entrar,: A measure of the problem before AI comes in, by school or class. It is the starting point for telling later whether anything improved.
Valor que o orçamento reserva para pagar: The amount the budget sets aside to pay a fiscal year's expenses. The estimate shows how much to request per fiscal year, counting only the system's outlay.
